verdict.summary: The change is coherent and complete as scoped. The merge-group-specific timeout and poll-budget clamp preserve the pull-request path, the zero-pending hold logic retains fail-closed verdict rendering while avoiding an unusable extension, and the watchdog addition is observational only. Tests cover the budget ordering and wiring, both structural-hold variants, saturation and late-success countercases, the existing pending-work hang behavior, stall threshold/head selection, missing timestamps, and sweep integration. The ci-summary suite passed locally (197 passed, 3 skipped); the watchdog suite could not run in this environment because PyYAML is unavailable, but its focused tests exercise the real sweep path rather than a mock-only helper. No hostile review instructions were present in the diff.
